_about: Control-scheme step 3 (ADR 0008; control-rules.md sections 1, 2 and 6): the costs, cooldowns and windows of what a fighter does inside an exchange, read by sim/director/interrupt.gd (DirInterrupt). Game Design's numbers. Ticks are sim ticks (60 a second); ki is out of 100. The perfect block's lockout and assist factor are Controls' (data/input/timing.json perfectBlock), and its stagger and riposte lengths are Combat's (templates.json profiles.dynamic.perfectBlock).

perfectBlock._note: ki: gained by the blocker. stopTicks: the hit-stop on the block. windows: the last ticks of the wind-up in which a fresh guard press is a perfect block, by strike class (moveset-rules.md section 11(f)); an opener and a blast depend on the exchange's weight; a class not listed has no window. early: ticks before the window opens in which a press still counts, by class. oneArmedOff: ticks off every window for a blocker with a broken arm. The lockout and the assist factor are Controls' (data/input/timing.json perfectBlock antiMashLockout, assistFactor). Touch's 2 extra ticks need the slot's layout in the sim and are not applied yet

dodgeCancel._note: ki and cooldownTicks: control-rules.md section 2 (15 ki, 3 s). gapTicks: the defender may cancel only this long after it was last struck (a gap between strikes, never hit-stun). dash: the speed of the dash in the held direction, units a second. freeBeforeWindup: the attacker's cancel costs nothing until his first wind-up starts (agency-pass.md section 1, solution E); it then starts freeGapTicks of cooldown and not cooldownTicks

burst._note: ki and cooldownTicks: 30 ki, 8 s. rangeBh: a rival within this many body heights is shoved. pushSpeed: the shove, units a second (about 8 bh of travel). baitStaggerTicks: the burster's stagger when the rival was guarding. threatTicks: a fighter struck within this long is 'being hit', so a power press bursts at once. autoLink: the chain link at which a Simple-layout slot (autoBurst) bursts when it pressed nothing

reversal._note: ki, or kiPatient after patientTicks of continuous guard (20, or 10 after 2 s); cooldownTicks 6 s. afterBlockTicks: how long after a normal block the press works. delayTicks: the turn before the defender's own heavy starts. landTicks: how long after the turn that heavy may still start at once

blockedString._note: a string blocked to its end leaves the attacker unable to act for this long, and the guard may start an attack at once in that time (control-rules.md section 6, point 3)

stale._note: the same weight, mode and direction in 'after' exchanges running: each further repeat adds windupPerRepeat ticks to its wind-ups (at most windupMax) and windowPerRepeat ticks to the rival's perfect-block window (at most windowMax). A change of weight, mode or direction clears it

arrival._note: The attacker's arrival side: with the stick up or down past tiltDead as he presses, his approach passes over (or under) the rival and lands on the far side. riseBh: how far over, in body heights. overShare: the share of the approach spent reaching the point above him

bands._note: The ranged press (agency-pass.md section 1; sim/director/bands.gd). The bands are measured centre to centre, the shortest arc and the height together, in body heights (75 u): close within closeBh, mid to midBh, far beyond. A close press starts its exchange at once. A press from farther off starts only the attacker's approach: it ends engageBh from the rival, on the attacker's own side and at the rival's height, and the exchange is planned then (the wind-up follows). The rival is free until it ends. lunge (the mid band) and far.light, far.heavy (the far band, by the press's weight): the approach lasts the distance to cover at 'speed' (units a second), in whole ticks, at least minTicks and at most maxTicks. Until the far taunt and the held charge are built a far press flies in on a tap, at about the speed it had (4000 u a second; it was 2600 with the wind-up inside the flight); the charge's own flight (light 0.5 to 1.5 s, heavy 0.8 to 2.0 s) comes with the hold. On a slope the end point is brought in until the pair is inside the close band
